subject: Coord: POC lab session & sample ingest - alignment and reschedule
messages:
From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Anil Kapoor <anil.kapoor@brightbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC lab session — sample ingest & ops prep

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was encouraged by the latency and routing controls you showed. We'd like to run a 3-hour hands-on lab with your engineers to validate prompt routing and run light load tests with our representative payloads.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 25, 10:00–13:00
- Wed Nov 26, 09:00–12:00

We will share a sample manifest and ~2k short prompts (de-identified where necessary). Two asks before we lock the calendar:
1) Redaction guidance — we need to confirm acceptable redaction placeholders for PHI and whether structural markers (JSON keys) must be preserved.
2) Load targets — we want a smoke load of 50 concurrent short requests and a burst to 200 qps for 90s to validate autoscale behavior. Can Redwood support these in the Dedicated-like env for the session?

Attached: brightbridge_sample_manifest.csv (fields+counts). I'll follow up with the full zipped payload once you've confirmed the path for uploads (S3 presigned? secure Drive?).

Thanks — cc'ing Anil (platform).

— Susan
Susan Lee
Head of Data Platform, BrightBridge Health
+1 (415) 555-0172
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@brightbridgehealth.com>, Anil Kapoor <anil.kapoor@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-19T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC lab session — sample ingest & ops prep

Susan — great to hear and thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

Redaction guidance: We ask that you replace PHI values with the token <REDACTED_PH> while preserving field names and types. For free text where context matters, use <REDACTED> and keep punctuation. We attached our short redaction-guidelines.pdf as a checklist (fields to keep/remove, size limits). Please keep a mapping locally — we don't need the mapping itself.

Load targets: We can run the smoke load in our staging pool attached to your session. 50 concurrent short requests + a 200 qps 90s burst is doable; we'll provision a temporary isolated pool and instrument KV cache priming to reduce cold-starts. If you want true Dedicated-level isolation, we can spin a reserved pool but that requires procurement sign-off — for the hands-on lab we'll emulate the throughput in staging.

Dates: Wed Nov 26, 09:00–12:00 PST works best for our infra and eng availability. I'll tentatively hold that slot. Please confirm by EOD Mon Nov 24.

Uploads: We'll accept S3 presigned URLs (preferred) or a secure Drive folder. I'll send an S3 bucket path with upload keys after you confirm.

Please attach: one representative JSONL (max 500 records) and one evaluation set of 200 prompts with expected labels so we can run baseline scoring during the session.

I'm attaching the updated agenda (poc_session-agenda_v2.pdf) with the prompt review and routing test plan.

Next steps:
- Susan: confirm Wed Nov 26 and upload one JSONL + eval set by Nov 24.
- Priyom: can you prepare the routing scenarios (latency vs cost fallback) and a basic canary rollback plan?
- Rishi: please confirm any commercial constraints (trial resources / procurement).

Thanks — looking forward.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Anil / Susan — thanks for the note. Thu Nov 27 08:30–11:30 PST works for us. Confirming two quick items from commercial / compliance side:

1) Key management & audit logs — we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM for Private deployments; for hosted/staging presigned S3 uploads we'll provide access logs and object-level read events for the sample bucket. I'll share the SOC2 control mapping pdf with the procurement contact (link below).

2) Procurement timeline — we can run the lab before an executed SOW as a technical eval. If you want reserved Dedicated capacity later we will need a short commitment window; we'll scope that in the SOW.

Operational fallback: if the burst triggers throttling in staging, Irene and Priyom will run a fallback plan that routes to a lower-latency quantized model and replay the prompts for throughput verification.

Irene — please confirm you will send the presigned S3 path and test prompt template. Priyom / Grace — please be on the call for run-of-show and routing verification.

Subject: Re: POC lab session — sample ingest & ops prep (confirmed)

Thanks all — Thu Nov 27, 08:30–11:30 PST is confirmed and I'll send calendar invites in a minute. Key operational notes / acceptance checklist for sample delivery:

1) File types: one JSONL (records per line) + one CSV manifest with field counts. Max upload bundle 250 MB compressed.
2) Redaction: replace PHI with <REDACTED_PH> and free-text PII with <REDACTED>. Preserve JSON keys and array structure. See attached redaction-guidelines.pdf.
3) Upload path: we will provide presigned S3 URLs. Please upload to the path using the manifest filenames exactly as listed in the manifest.
4) Test prompts & eval set: include 200 evaluation prompts with expected labels and 20 routing-edge prompts (latency-sensitive). We'll run automatic scoring and a manual spot-check.
4) Load plan: start with a smoke run at 50 concurrent for 60s, then two 90s bursts peaking at 200 qps. If staging CPU or token pipeline exceeds thresholds we'll switch to the fallback quantized model as discussed.
5) Acceptance criteria: 95th percentile latency under 400ms for short prompts during the smoke run; scoring delta < 3% vs baseline on eval set.

Attachments: redaction-guidelines.pdf, poc_session-agenda_v2.pdf.

Upload deadline for the JSONL + eval set: Mon Nov 24, 23:59 PST. If you need an SFTP alternative, let me know and we'll arrange it with Security.

See you Thu — calendar invite attached.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
